channel.title: Technology on Pranav Buradkar
channel.description: Recent content in Technology on Pranav Buradkar

item.title: Demystifying Mixed Precision Training: Speeding Up Deep Learning with FP16 and BF16
item.description: An in-depth guide on how mixed precision training works, the mathematics of loss scaling, the difference between FP16 and BF16, and how to implement it in PyTorch.

item.title: Mastering NVIDIA Omniverse Kit SDK: From App Templates to Custom Extensions
item.description: An in-depth developer guide to building modular 3D applications, microservices, and custom UI extensions using the NVIDIA Omniverse Kit SDK.

item.title: A Simple Guide to LLM Serving: Quantization, KV Caching, and Continuous Batching
item.description: Dive into the three key techniques that make serving large language models (LLMs) fast, cheap, and memory-efficient.

item.title: How to Fine-Tune Llama 3 on Your Own Data: A Practical Guide
item.description: Step-by-step practical guide to fine-tuning Meta's Llama 3 using PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, and PEFT/LoRA on a custom dataset.

item.title: A Simple Guide to LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation)
item.description: Learn how Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) makes fine-tuning massive LLMs and generative models incredibly efficient.

item.title: Deep Learning Fundamentals: Attention Mechanisms and Vision Transformers
item.description: Breaking down the mechanics of Self-Attention and understanding how the Transformer architecture leaped from Natural Language Processing to dominating Computer Vision with ViTs.

item.title: A Simple Guide to Variational Autoencoders (VAEs)
item.description: Dive into the world of VAEs, understand how they generate new data, and explore their applications in AI.

item.title: A Beginner's Guide to LLM Quantization: GGUF, GPTQ, and AWQ
item.description: Expanding on LLM optimization by explaining how massive models are compressed using techniques like GGUF, GPTQ, and AWQ to run on consumer hardware.

item.title: A Simple Guide to GANs
item.description: Understand the core concepts of GANs, how they work, and their applications in AI.
